titles.title: Hazbin Hotel
titles.description: An adult animated musical comedy created by Vivienne Medrano. Charlie, the princess of Hell, opens a hotel to rehabilitate sinners in the hope of sending them to Heaven.

titles.title: Helluva Boss
titles.description: An adult animated comedy series created by Vivienne Medrano. It follows the Immediate Murder Professionals (I.M.P.), a small crew of imps who run an assassination business in Hell.
